关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported its results for the three months ended December 31, 2011. The company announced that net earnings increased by 20% to $5,363,000 compared to $4,475,000 for the same period in 2010. Diluted net earnings per share rose by 18% to $0.45, up from $0.38 in the prior year period. Revenue also increased by 7% to $17,140,000, compared to $15,995,000 in the same period of 2010. The report was filed as part of Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on February 2, 2012.
